target_customer: Companies adding facial biometric login and identity verification to workforce single sign-on
problem: Passwords and phishing enable account takeover; Entry added a sensorless facial biometric factor with anti-spoofing.
product_category: Biometric single sign-on and identity verification

founders.name: Emil Mikhailov
founders.role: Founder and CEO (former CEO of XIX.ai)
founders.background_notes: YC profile; Cribl role came after Entry.

competitors.name: Kairos
competitors.traction_then: Founder claimed up to 99 percent identification accuracy

technical_complexity.rationale: Facial recognition with anti-spoofing for login needed ML research quality accuracy against spoof attacks in 2017.

defensibility.rationale: Model quality helped but several biometric vendors and big platforms offered face login.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source documents their reaction; Entry's later history is not public.

market_need_then: YC page ties demand to phishing and account takeover; no dated 2017 spend data was found.

brand_strength.rationale: A generic word with no found press, community or brand assets; trademark filed only for XIX in 2021.

outcome_analysis: Entry was the sensorless face login product of XIX.ai, a Winter 2017 company whose founder reports over 5 million dollars raised from YC, Two Bear Capital, CabraVC and angels. YC lists it Inactive and the founder as former CEO, but no shutdown, sale or post-mortem was found, so the outcome and cause are not public.
notes: No company website is listed so none was fetched. The founder statement of 5M+ is a total with no round breakdown; the Preqin seed (2017-03, NewDo and YC) rests on a single database and Preqin dates look questionable. Round amounts and dates not given. Competitors Kairos and ID R&D come from search results not opened; Kairos source is 2014. Education of founder not found.
